title: Dynamics 365 Sales: copy a Sales Development agent's configuration to another agent
summary: Hold: the cost assessment omits published consumption billing for Sales Development agents beginning December 1, 2026. The briefing also overstates the absence of export logging: general Agent 365 invocation and tool-call auditing is documented, although a configuration-export-specific event remains unconfirmed.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Cost is low because the published costs consist only of manager time and existing agent licenses.
claims.quote:
Public Preview availability | November 24, 2026 | December 1, 2026 | December 1, 2026 |
Consumption billing begins when each product becomes available.
All agent activity is billed consumptively.
claims.fix: Set cost to 'variable'. Replace the cost rationale with 'Variable. Microsoft publishes consumption billing via Copilot Credits for Sales Development agents from December 1, 2026; no export/import-specific rate is published.' Add to Cost and licensing: 'The Microsoft 365 Resources for Agents service description lists Sales Development Agent public preview availability as December 1, 2026, when consumption billing begins. It publishes 100 Copilot Credits per agent per month for the agent account and persistent resource access, and says all agent activity, including model, context, tools and runtime usage, is billed consumptively. The activation page still describes the $0 preview SKU; that SKU price does not establish that agent activity is unmetered.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/office-365-platform-service-description/microsoft-365-resources-for-agents. Keep the narrower statement that no configuration-export/import-specific rate is published.
